Russia

Travel Advisory

29 June 2026

In view of the ongoing conflict, Singaporeans are advised to continue to defer non-essential travel to Russia. Singaporeans in Russia should remain vigilant, monitor local news and heed the advice of the local authorities. Flights may be disrupted at short notice and payment cards issued outside Russia may not work.

Visa information

Singapore passport holders may stay visa-free for up to 30 days. Please check with the nearest Russian embassy for the latest entry requirements before travelling.
